parasite-2019.summary: People describe this as "laughing at one moment & then questioning that laughter the next" and as "a black comedy, a suspenseful thriller and a dash of horror." That is basically the pitch: it keeps throwing the room off balance in a good way, but the tension never lets up.
parasite-2019.good_pick_if: you want something tense, sharp, and really easy to talk about after
parasite-2019.maybe_skip_if: you want something way more chill or tonally steady

source_quotes.text: a cleverly layered & defiantly eclectic extravaganza that will have you laughing at one moment & then questioning that laughter the next.
what I got was a black comedy, a suspenseful thriller and a dash of horror.

singin-in-the-rain.summary: People call this "incredibly fun, innovative, charming and entertaining" and even "the most charming film I've ever watched." That feels right. It is bright, loose, and absurdly easy to like, so the craft never feels stiff or homework-y.
singin-in-the-rain.good_pick_if: you want something bright, polished, and easy for a group to get into
singin-in-the-rain.maybe_skip_if: you want something moodier or more low-key

source_quotes.text: Incredibly fun, innovative, charming and entertaining.
This is perhaps the most charming film I've ever watched.

the-apartment.summary: People say "The Apartment puts all of the other rom-coms to shame" and admit they ended it "smiling like an idiot." That pretty much nails it. It is funny, a little lonely, and sneakily warm, so the romance feels earned instead of sugary.
the-apartment.good_pick_if: you want a classic that still feels funny, human, and a little bittersweet
the-apartment.maybe_skip_if: you want something breezier or less emotionally up close

source_quotes.text: The Apartment puts all of the other rom-coms to shame.
I ended "The Apartment" smiling like an idiot.
